hooks.command:
cfg="${AGY_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}/.agents/team.toml"; fallback="${AGY_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}/.agents/team.toml"; legacy="${AGY_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}/.agents/team.config"; if [ -f "$cfg" ]; then printf '=== mARC :: per-repo team.toml (channel topic) ===
'; cat "$cfg"; printf '
=== end team.toml ===
'; elif [ -f "$fallback" ]; then printf '=== mARC :: per-repo team.toml (channel topic) ===
'; cat "$fallback"; printf '
=== end team.toml ===
'; printf '[mARC] DEPRECATED path: .agents/team.toml — re-run /marc:init to migrate to .agents/team.toml (it will offer to remove the old file).
'; elif [ -f "$legacy" ]; then printf '[mARC] DEPRECATED: .agents/team.config found but mARC now reads .agents/team.toml (or .agents/team.toml as a fallback) — re-run /marc:init (or convert by hand from docs/team.toml.example) to migrate; the old .agents/team.config file is no longer parsed.
'; else printf '[mARC] no .agents/team.toml (or .agents/team.toml) in this repo — @techlead will fall back to runtime discovery (gh repo view / gh project list). Add one from docs/team.toml.example to pin repo/project facts.
'; fi; exit 0

export CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT="${AGY_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="${AGY_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; script="${AGY_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/outdated-check.sh"; if [ -f "$script" ]; then bash "$script" 2>/dev/null; else echo "[mARC] hook script not found: $script (is AGY_PLUGIN_ROOT set for this harness?)" >&2; fi; exit 0
